reason: I'm not making an account on some TikTok settlement site so a startup can store my identity details. If I actually thought I qualified, I'd go to the official administrator myself.
objection: Free-during-beta with a paid model coming later just sounds like they'll harvest my info then hit me with a fee, and I assume these sites are scams until I see the official claims page with no middleman.
would_change_my_mind: No account, no email, no stored personal info — just listings that deep-link to the official notice for a company I actually use.
